questions.question: Which committee was set up to review the concept of the poverty line?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**S Tendulkar Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The current estimations of poverty are based upon the recommendations of the **S Tendulkar Committee.**
 
• It was formed in **2005 **and strongly recommended to shift away from a calorie-based model.
 
• The cost of living was adopted as the basis for identifying poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Lakdawala Committee-

__
 
• Planning Commission in September 1989 appointed D.T.Lakadwala Committee. The committee submitted its report in January 1993.
 
• The Lakadwala committee used the Alagh committee's method but it declared separate poverty lines for each state, rural as well as urban.
 
• The committee used the Uniform Recall Period method.
 
• The government used this method from 1997 to 2011 for the measurement of poverty.

Wanchoo Committee__

__
 
• It is also known as the **'Direct Taxes Enquiry Committee'.**
 
• It was set up under the leadership of **Niranjan Nath Wanchoo.**
 
• He was a senior civil servant and Governor of Kerala and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Committee recommended that fiscal and financial resources should be spent to develop all backward areas.

Dutt Committee__

 
• It is also known as the** 'Industrial Licensing Policy Inquiry Committee'.**
 
• It was set up under **Mr Subimal Dutt.**
 
• The purpose of the commission was to enquire into the working of the licensing system in India.
 
• Some of the recommendations of the Committee were
 
• Larger industrial houses should be given licenses for setting up industry in core and heavy investment sectors.
 
• A monopolies commission should be established to deal with the problems of economic power.

questions.question: Which of the following places presents the oldest evidence of Neolithic Era?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Mehrgarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mehrgarh (6500 to 5500 BC)** is one of the** oldest Neolithic sites in South Asia.**
 
• It began during the** Pre-Harappan period.**
 
• It is located near the** Bolan Pass on the Kacchi Plain of Balochistan, Pakistan.**
 
• It is one of the** earliest sites with evidence of farming and herding.**
 
• Women and men learnt to grow** barley and** **wheat, and rear sheep and goats.**
 
• **Remains of square or rectangular houses** were found at the site.
 
• These people believe in life after death, this was visible from the burials which were found at the site.
 
• Mehrgarh was also a** centre of manufacture for various figures and pottery** that were distributed to surrounding regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Burzahom** is a** Neolithic site** in the district of Srinagar, India.
 
• The site is a **unique comprehensive storyteller of life between 3000 BCE to 1000 BCE.**
 
• It is a** UNESCO world heritage centre.**
 
• **Dalmabad** is a **Chalcolithic or copper age site** **(2200-1000 BCE)** on the left bank of river Pravara, a tributary of Godawari in the Ahmednagar district of Maharashtra.
 
• The site was discovered by** archaeologist BP Bopardikar in 1956.**
 
• One of the most significant discoveries from this site is the **Dalmabad man**, a bronze sculpture of a man riding a chariot drawn by a bull.

questions.question: According to the distance of planets from the Sun, which of the following order is correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The order of the planets in the solar system, starting nearest the sun and working outward is the following:

 
 
• Mercury
 
• Venus
 
• Earth
 
• Mars
 
• Jupiter
 
• Saturn
 
• Uranus
 
• Neptune
 
 
 
• The Solar System is made up of Sun and everything that orbits around it including planets, moons, asteroids, comets and meteoroids.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Sun The sun is in the centre of the solar system.
 
• It is huge and made up of extremely hot gases.
 
• It provides the pulling force that binds the solar system.
 
• The sun is the ultimate source of heat and light for the solar system.
 
• But that tremendous heat is not felt so much by us because despite being our nearest star, it is far away from us.
 
• The sun is about 150 million km away from the earth. 
 
• The inner planets get more heat and energy from the Sun, so they are warmer than the outer planets.
 
• The outer planets are comparatively colder as they receive less energy from the Sun due to large distances.
 
• The Solar System contains 8 planets:

 
 

 Inner or Terrestrial planets

 
 
 
 
 
 
• Mercury
 
• Venus
 
• Earth
 
• Mars
 
 
 
 

 
 Outer Planets or Jovian planets

 
 
 
 
 
 
• Jupiter
 
• Saturn
 
• Uranus
 
• Neptune

questions.question: Krishna Sobti is the recipient of the 53rd Jnanpith Award. Which of the following books has not been written by her?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishw Mithok Sarit Sagar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishna Sobti is **a Hindi fiction writer and essayist and for her contribution to Indian literature,
 
• She has received **Jnanpith Award in 2017**. She has also received the** Sahitya Akademi Award in 1980 for her novel Zindaginama.**
 
• Her other novels include** Mitro Marajani, Samay Sargam, Daar Se Bichchuri, Surajmukhi Andhere Ke, and Yaaron Ke Yaar.** While Vishw Mithok Sarit Sagar is written by Ramesh Kuntal Megh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Jnanpith Award

 
• Jnanpith Award is the oldest and the highest Indian literary award presented annually by the Bharatiya Jnanpith organization.
 
• It was instituted in 1961 and is awarded to an author for his/her outstanding contribution to literature. 
 
• The award is bestowed only on Indian writers writing in Indian languages included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India and English. 
 
• The winner is given a cash prize of Rs.13 lakh and a bronze replica of Goddess Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of learning.

questions.question: Which type of city administration controls larger urban area?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Municipal Corporation__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Councils, and Municipal Corporations are all Urban Governance Bodies responsible to generate revenue through taxes and deliver services to the citizens.
 
 
• Nagar Panchayat is for towns with populations between 11,000 and 25,000 people.
 
• Municipal Councils are for towns between 25,000 and 100,000 in population.
 
• A Municipal Corporation is to govern cities with a population of more than 100,000 people.
 
• 
 
Hence, from the above points, we can clearly infer that a Municipal Corporation controls a larger urban area.

questions.question: Which among the following is **NOT** an event during the photosynthesis process?

options.text: Absorption of light energy by chlorophyll
Conversion of light energy to chemical energy
Splitting of water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen
Oxidation of carbon dioxide to carbohydrates

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is the __**Oxidation of carbon dioxide to carbohydrates.**__

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants prepare their own food. The events during photosynthesis are:
 
 
• 1) Absorption of light energy by chlorophyll.
 
• 2) Conversion of light energy to chemical energy and splitting of water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen.
 
• 3) Reduction of carbon dioxide into carbohydrates.
 
 
 
• Photosynthesis is the process through which green plants synthesize or prepare carbohydrates or food from sunlight, carbon dioxide (CO2), and water.__
 
• Photosynthesis is a reduction process that involves the reduction of carbon dioxide to carbohydrates.
 
• In the presence of light, green plants fix carbon dioxide to complex molecules like carbohydrates.
 
• Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplast of the cell.
 
• Chlorophyll is a green pigment that is found in the leaves of plants. 
 
• It helps plants to absorb sunlight energy. 
 
• This energy is used to prepare food by combining carbon dioxide and water.
 
• Plants with chlorophyll pigments may perform photosynthesis by absorbing light energy. 
 
• The conversion of light energy to chemical energy occurs during the photosynthesis process.
 
• The splitting of water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen is known as photooxidation.

questions.question: The smallest blood vessels which are one-cell thick, are called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Capillaries.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• The smallest blood vessels which are one cell thick, are called Capillaries.
 
• Their main function is to enable the exchange of substances between the blood and surrounding tissues.
 
• They provide nutrients and oxygen to tissues and remove the byproducts of cellular reactions, such as carbon dioxide and water.
 
• The Vena cava is a large vein that returns deoxygenated blood from the body to the heart.
 
• Arteries are the blood vessels that deliver blood from the heart to the body. Veins are blood vessels that carry blood toward the heart.

questions.question: During ________ motion of an object along a straight line, the velocity remains constant with time.
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Uniform.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Uniform motion is a motion in which a body moves in a specific direction at a constant speed.
 
• Uniform motion: when an object covers an equal distance in an equal time interval of time said to be in uniform motion. Here acceleration is zero.
 
• When a body moves in a perfect circle at a constant speed then it is called Uniform circular motion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9da31ac692e19833bbb185bde1d0751945bddb28f61777bda20ee2acf16f7418.png] 

 
• **Non-Uniform motion:** when an object covers unequal distances in the equal time interval of time said to be in non-uniform motion. Here acceleration is non-zero.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54b61f50b742c0c0242fbbf5e7060d435c2826d7c578c7b7f1137b2d52ce51b5.png]

questions.question: In Microsoft word, under character formatting ________ is used to apply colours to the characters.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Font Colour__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Font Colour**

 
 
• It is used to apply **colours to the characters.**
 
• This option is present in the **Home tab.**
 
• The** default font colour is Black. ​**Select the text you want to modify.
 
• On the Home tab, click the** Font Color drop-down** arrow. The Font Color menu appears.
 
• Select the font colour you want to use. The font colour will change in the document.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Font size** 

 
 
• It is used to **change the size of the font.**
 
• Navigate to the Home tab, and click the Font size drop-down arrow. 
 
• Select a font size from the menu. 
 
• If the font size you need is not available in the menu, you can click the Font size box and type the desired font size, then press Enter.
 
• The font size will change in the document.
 
 
 
• **Font Style**
 
 
• By default, the font of each new document is set to **Calibri**. 
 
• But Word provides many other fonts you can use to customize the text.
 
• Select the text you want to modify.
 
• Click the drop-down arrow next to the** Font box. **
 
• A menu of font styles will appear, select the font style you want to use.
